armchair.green.note: wingback: full-width back to the cushion, a top roll, and the wings ears either side

armchair.rust.note: wingback: full-width back to the cushion, a top roll, and the wings ears either side

couch.green.note: Chesterfield: rolled arms as a lower block plus a roll; the tufted back leans (front face v 0.45 at the cushion, 0.535 at the top roll).

heirloom-throne.note: throne: cushion on its chest between low arms; a sunburst back, one slab stepped up to its peak; paw feet

ottoman.green.note: round tufted pouf: the cushion drum = plus + thin cross (front edge at the rim), 4 turned feet on the diagonals; sit a little forward of centre so the knees reach the rim

stool.note: round oak bar stool, radial (same in every facing): cushion disc = plus + thin cross (the front edge at the rim), leg column + footring plate, 4 splayed legs in 3 tiers; sit a little forward of centre so the legs come off the rim

stool.drafting.note: drafting stool: round cushion = plus + thin cross, gas-lift stem, foot-ring plate, hub, five-star base as mirrored arm boxes (the drawn star is 5-armed and off-centre: IoU capped ~0.80)

stool.neon.note: round chrome pedestal stool, radial (same in every facing): thick vinyl cushion = plus + thin cross (front edge at the rim), post, foot-ring plate, base plate; sit a little forward of centre so the legs come off the rim
